reader.requirement: At 1985 STRING must refuse an identifier-1 (sender) or identifier-2 (delimiter) that is an elementary numeric item with decimal places (V) or the symbol P (leading or trailing), and accept integer numeric items (signed or not, up to 18 digits), groups holding non-integer items, and numeric-edited items, which are not numeric.

reader.notes: Sr8Offence (named after the 2023 rule number) tests elementary numeric with non-zero scale, which covers V and both P forms, and is asked at both the sending and the delimiter positions. The signed sender's image carries its trailing overpunch (1234E), the item's own DISPLAY representation.
